verdict.rationale: Clerky's Partner API lets partners embed formation data collection in their own product, but the docs state that signing stays on Clerky: users "sign documents on Clerky" and "Clerky handles signing." That is an adjacent capability, not an embedded signing experience, and the pack has no evidence of embeddable or in-app signing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the signing experience inside my own app or website

citations.quote: The Clerky Partner API lets partners bring a Clerky-powered formation workflow into their own product.
Your product owns data collection and progress display; Clerky handles signing and formation work.
